---
title: "7 · Adversarial and Diffusion Models"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

Generators trained without a likelihood: generative adversarial networks, the best discriminator, the Jensen–Shannon divergence and the Wasserstein distance, mode collapse, conditional GANs. Diffusion models: the forward noising process, training a noise predictor, the reverse step and the score, the U-Net. Spin configurations of the 2D Ising model generated at a chosen temperature and checked against Monte Carlo through physical observables.
